lean.statement:
(Φ : E × E → E) (hΦ : Measurable Φ) (c : E × E → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable c)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (hAtop : A ≠ ⊤)
    (hcost : ∀ x y ζ, c (Φ (x,ζ),Φ (y,ζ)) ≤ A*c (x,y))
    (μ ν Γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure Γ] :
    Transport.transportCost c ((μ.prod Γ).map Φ) ((ν.prod Γ).map Φ) ≤
      A * Transport.transportCost c μ ν
approved_definition_context: E is a normed additive group with its Borel measurable space and second-countable topology. Phi is a measurable map from E×E to E; c is a measurable extended nonnegative cost on endpoint pairs. The three displayed laws are probability measures.

Transport.transportCost c mu nu is sInf {r | exists a measure gamma on E×E with gamma.fst=mu and gamma.snd=nu and r=lintegral c gamma}. No optimizer or finite-cost convention is imposed. Measure.prod is the independent product measure; Measure.map is measurable pushforward.

A is an extended nonnegative real, nonzero and different from infinity. The cost premise is pointwise for every pair and every shared noise sample. Products/multiplication use extended-real conventions.
